code: if (*line == '[') {/* This is the beginning if a scope */
note: A config line beginning with '[' is treated as a scope declaration and passed into the scope parser.
The parser searches for the closing bracket that bounds the scope name.
The safety obligation is that a scope declaration must contain at least one character before the closing bracket; otherwise later length-based handling is invalid.
The substring between '[' and ']' is copied into a newly allocated scope string.
The copied scope string is validated before being stored globally.
The validated scope string becomes the active global scope used by later parsing.
